sources.title: IAASB 2025 Handbook, Volume 1
sources.application: Separate control design, implementation and effectiveness; distinguish contributor types and require auditor evaluation. Direct assistance requires applicable permission. The relevant edition and local legal adoption must be evidenced by the engagement, rather than inferred from this international reference.

boundaries: No universal materiality percentage, credential expiry, risk rating, assertion code or direct-assistance permission is invented.
Actual production identity and conditional external portals remain separately scoped.
